title: Ellijay River Vineyards
specs: Located at 1400 feet elevation in North Georgia mountains
Vineyards planted with Seyval Blanc, Albarino, Viognier, and Merlot grapes
blurb: Ellijay River Vineyards is located on almost twenty acres bordering the Ellijay River in North Georgia. They cultivate several grape varieties including Seyval Blanc, Albarino, Viognier, and Merlot. Visitors are welcome by appointment to learn about the vineyard and its grapes.
